system.boundary: Build an engine-driven road-vehicle model in Simulink and Simscape Driveline with a six-forward-speed dual-clutch transmission.
engineering_objects: F90-XMECH-03 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, engine_torque_demand
physical_paths: The physical drivetrain must contain two distinct controllable friction-clutch power paths serving interleaved odd and even gear ratios, a common transmission output, a final drive, and a vehicle load.

Prescribed vehicle motion, direct replay of the requested speed as measured speed, a fixed-ratio or single-clutch drivetrain disguised as a dual-clutch transmission, and disconnected decorative drivetrain components are not valid.
functional_paths: The physical drivetrain must contain two distinct controllable friction-clutch power paths serving interleaved odd and even gear ratios, a common transmission output, a final drive, and a vehicle load.
The vehicle speed must be controlled in closed loop to follow the requested speed profile.
The detailed controller, shift logic, and actuator implementation are not prescribed.
information_paths: speed_command, vehicle_mass_kg, clutch_capacity_scale -> F90-XMECH-03 plant/control path -> speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, engine_torque_demand
modes_and_events: Build an engine-driven road-vehicle model in Simulink and Simscape Driveline with a six-forward-speed dual-clutch transmission.

interfaces.name: speed_command
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read speed_command, vehicle_mass_kg, and clutch_capacity_scale from the MATLAB base workspace. speed_command is a complete Timeseries in km/h with values from 0 to 120 km/h. Simulate the complete interval carried by speed_command for every supported operating condition. Every logged signal must come from the same causal simulation and cover the full speed_command interval.

interfaces.name: vehicle_mass_kg
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read speed_command, vehicle_mass_kg, and clutch_capacity_scale from the MATLAB base workspace. vehicle_mass_kg has a nominal value of 1600 kg and must be supported from 1360 to 1840 kg.

interfaces.name: clutch_capacity_scale
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read speed_command, vehicle_mass_kg, and clutch_capacity_scale from the MATLAB base workspace. clutch_capacity_scale has a nominal value of 1.0 and must be supported from 0.85 to 1.0; it must change the physical torque capacity of both transmission clutches rather than only a reported value.

interfaces.name: speed_response
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Record four complete Timeseries named speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, and engine_torque_demand. speed_response contains [requested speed, measured physical vehicle speed] in km/h.

interfaces.name: engine_speed
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Record four complete Timeseries named speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, and engine_torque_demand. engine_speed contains measured physical engine speed in rpm.

interfaces.name: transmission_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Record four complete Timeseries named speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, and engine_torque_demand. transmission_state contains [selected gear state, odd-clutch pressure in Pa, even-clutch pressure in Pa, odd-clutch slip in rpm, even-clutch slip in rpm].

interfaces.name: engine_torque_demand
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Record four complete Timeseries named speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, and engine_torque_demand. engine_torque_demand contains the demanded engine torque in N*m.
